# The environment for the pip based test matrix in CI, which only runs the
# pytest suite against every interpreter `req-compile` supports.
#
# Bazel is the source of truth for pinned dependencies (see the per platform
# lock files next to this file, and `bazel-requirements.in`). This file is
# deliberately left unpinned so that pip resolves a working set for whatever
# interpreter is being tested, the same way a user installing `req-compile`
# would get one.
--index-url https://pypi.org/simple

-r ../requirements.in

# Test only dependencies.
pytest
pytest-mock
responses
six  # needed by tests/source-packages/extern-importer-1.0/setup.py fixture
